subject: A few questions about errors with Xtables as well as multiple items selected

messages.author: 75f79ff907a797ec
messages.subject: A few questions about errors with Xtables as well as multiple items selected
parts:
To start off I am relatively new at using R, but I have been trying my best to learn and soak up knowledge as much as possible.

A little background:
My job recently tasked me with coding a user interface to show clients data we have collected for them on a website. I stumbled upon this package and in a limited time was able to produce tables that were live queried from our mySQL! AWESOME!

My next task is to add in more intractability with respect to date, charts ect.

First question: (Multiple selected items from a list)

 I made a simple drop down bar that lists device names in which each device queries the SQL data base and up pops the data associated with that device. 

selectInput("sweetsense", "Device:",
              choices = (sensorname$code), multiple = TRUE)

How does shiny deal with the  "multiple selections" option of the drop down list menu. Because I want users to be able to select multiple items and with each selection up pops the data (and eventually a graph associated with their selections). More specifically how do I tell the server that the user has selected multiple inputs from the list?

Second question: error with x tables
I've noticed that if I change my SQL query with respect to how dates are printed I get an "x table" error

WORKING CODE
datasetInput <-reactive(function()(sqlQuery(ch,paste("SELECT * From ",input$sweetsense,"_Events",sep=""))));

CODE W/ ERROR
datasetInput <- reactive(function()(sqlQuery(ch,paste("SELECT FROM_UNIXTIME((PeaksP1Time),'%Y %D %M %h:%i:%s %x'), PeaksP1, FROM_UNIXTIME((PeaksP2Time),'%Y %D %M %h:%i:%s %x'),PeaksP2 FROM ",input$sweetsense,"_Events",sep=""))));

Error:
Error in UseMethod("xtable") : 
  no applicable method for 'xtable' applied to an object of class "character"


I hope I have given enough detail, if not I answer any and all questions. Any help would be most appreciated.


Zak White

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: A few questions about errors with Xtables as well as multiple items selected
parts: How does shiny deal with the  "multiple selections" option of the drop down list menu. Because I want users to be able to select multiple items and with each selection up pops the data (and eventually a graph associated with their selections). More specifically how do I tell the server that the user has selected multiple inputs from the list?
In server.R, input$sweetsense should be a character vector of the selected values. Is that what you're asking?

Second question: error with x tables
I've noticed that if I change my SQL query with respect to how dates are printed I get an "x table" error

It's hard to know without seeing/running your actual code, but one thing I'd recommend is in your reactivePrint function, put the result table into a variable, then call browser(). That will drop you into a Browse> prompt where you can inspect the value of local variables. I think you will find that what you thought was a data frame or matrix turned out to be a character vector, at least that's what the error message seems to indicate.

sql <- sqlQuery(ch,paste("SELECT PeaksP1Time, PeaksP1, PeaksP2Time, PeaksP2 From LSF20_39cd3e_Events", sep=""));

barplot(sql$2) this yields a simple bar plot from this data frame.

Now when I want to re-actively make plots based off of user queried data, I receive a character vector that looks like this.

"1 structure(function () 2 { 3 if (!.initialized) { 4 .initialized <<- TRUE 5 .self$.updateValue() 6 }"
I got this by doing a reactive print
server.R (code as follows)
     output$plot <- reactivePrint(function(){
    head(datasetInput)
})

ui.R (code as follows)
 tableOutput("plot")

So I guess my question is how can I display a simple bar graph where the data it self changes based on a select input by the user? It seems as if your tutorial touches on this, but not in quite the same manner as I am proposing.

messages.subject: Re: A few questions about errors with Xtables as well as multiple items selected
parts:
Regular reactive functions shouldn't change/transform the values they produce at all--if they do, it's a bug. (reactivePrint, reactiveText, reactiveTable, reactivePlot, those are another story...)

This, for example, should work just fine:

df <- reactive(function() {
  cars
})

output$plot <- reactivePlot(function() {
  plot(df())
})
